pre_submit_contract.preview: available, every readiness bit true, CanSend true, and actionable auto/final-AI acceptance
pre_submit_contract.binding: snapshot, public/native revision, proof epoch, date, canonical interaction key, full actor/recipient IDs and typed payload fingerprint match the request
pre_submit_contract.stability: two complete preview envelopes are equal before submit, including CanSend, signed ten-slot costs, acceptance and payload
pre_submit_contract.budget: every positive actor cost slot is less than or equal to its independently supplied nonnegative per-resource maximum; negative slots do not consume budget
pre_submit_contract.religion: any selected religious option is deferred and cannot submit; ordinary feudal/clan is required for the vassalization slice
pre_submit_contract.submit: the callback is invoked at most once; its true result creates only submitted_verification_pending and occupies the single in-flight state

receipt_contract.authority: a later newer paused observation with exact proposal binding and interaction-specific world state
receipt_contract.pending: a matching pending proposal keeps the action in response_pending and does not permit resubmission
receipt_contract.applied: only the mapped world-state postcondition clears the in-flight state as applied
receipt_contract.ack_rule: the submit callback ACK is never an applied receipt

native_cases: all eleven allowlisted keys submit once and require their mapped receipt
unknown key, incomplete payload, religious option and non-ordinary vassalization reject
unready preview, CanSend false, AI refusal and over-budget cost reject
frame, cost or acceptance drift between captures rejects before submit
one in-flight submission blocks duplicate submit
ACK-only, response-pending, applied and failed postcondition states remain distinct
